devices.name: Meng Qi Wingie2
devices.tagline: Handheld stereo resonator with two keyboards and microphone inputs, on an ESP32

devices.name: Moog Music Mother-32
devices.tagline: Semi-modular analog desktop synth with a 32-step sequencer and 32 patch points

entries.name: FM1 Sampler for MPC One

devices.name: Akai Professional MPC Live / Live II / X / One / Key 61

entries.summary: Port of the FM1 Sampler sound engine to an Akai MPC plugin, with six sample-playing modes, envelope, LFO, arpeggiator, tape and effects, packed with LooperX on a ready-to-copy SD card image.

entries.name: XMP OS

devices.name: Akai Professional MPC Live / Live II / X / One / Key 61

entries.summary: Clip-based music workstation OS for the original MPC Live (Mk1) that boots from a USB key, with a browser version, an SDK and a graphical installer for macOS and Windows.

entries.name: Bandwerk

devices.name: Cleveland Music Co. Hothouse DSP Pedal Kit

entries.summary: Multiband bass pedal firmware for Daisy Seed pedals: an LR4 crossover, a compressor per band, an FX loop on the high band with automatic latency compensation, an octaver and three drive types.

entries.name: Beat & Dungeon
entries.summary: Skiff 2.7.1 fork that turns the FM-1 into a dungeon game: each room opens a track, a D20 sets the rule for composing it, and curses and creatures edit tracks you already made.

entries.name: BOSSA LOUNGE
entries.summary: Self-playing bossa nova firmware for the FM-1 that generates tunes for a small combo of nylon guitar, brushes, upright bass and flute or vibraphone, with a hi-fi and a neon martini glass on screen.

entries.name: CHIP TRACKER
entries.summary: Self-playing 8-bit game music firmware for the FM-1 that generates songs on four console-style channels and shows them as a scrolling tracker with live oscilloscopes.

entries.name: CITY POP
entries.summary: Self-playing 1980s city pop firmware for the FM-1 that generates whole songs with slap bass, electric piano, chorus guitar, brass and a sax or synth lead, over a screen of a city at dusk seen from a car stereo.

entries.name: DECAY LOOPS
entries.summary: Self-playing tape looper firmware for the FM-1 whose recorded phrases wear away as they play, after William Basinski's Disintegration Loops, with two turning reels on screen.

entries.name: DEEP HOUSE DECKS
entries.summary: Self-playing deep house firmware for the FM-1 that generates an endless set of records at 118 to 124 BPM and shows a virtual DJ blending them on two turntables and a mixer.

entries.name: DUB DESK
entries.summary: Self-playing roots dub firmware for the FM-1 where a reggae band plays sixteen riddims while a virtual engineer mixes live with drops, echo throws, spring crashes and sirens.

entries.name: DUB R39
entries.summary: Experimental dub-techno instrument with four tracks, up to eight oscillators per synth track, an eleven-part sample drum bank, a mixer, two delays, reverb, MIDI and a sequencer.

entries.name: FELT PIANO
entries.summary: Self-playing solo piano firmware for the FM-1 that generates pieces on a modelled felt piano and draws each note as a fading line of light on a scrolling piano roll.

entries.name: FM-1 Again
entries.summary: Garage and dance groove firmware with soft FM electric piano, sung syllables, a chopped recording and a reversed stab on the keys, eight grooves, builds and drops, performance tricks and a pumping sidechain.

entries.name: FM-1 Agent Console
entries.summary: Turns the FM-1 into a hardware console for coding-agent sessions in Traycer: a screen with each session's state, answer and age, key and knob input for approving, denying and prompting, and a macOS companion app.

entries.name: FM-1 Big Screen builds
entries.summary: Third-party repository of 172 prebuilt FM-1 community firmware packages, each rebuilt from its author's published source with the Big Screen screen-output addition, with a table of credit, license and source commit.

entries.name: COMPOSER
entries.summary: Library-player firmware for pieces of up to eight parts made on a computer, with a browser studio where an AI text-to-MIDI model writes a piece and an emulated FM-1 plays it.

entries.name: FM1-Hero
entries.summary: Falling-note piano trainer and rhythm game with a six-voice two-operator FM synth: key LEDs show the next notes, with wait, game and auto modes and MIDI file import.

entries.name: FM1 Mix
entries.summary: Android app that runs an emulated FM-1 firmware on the phone and mixes it with the USB audio of a real FM-1, with a touch panel, MIDI clock sync, effects pad, loop player, slicer and project files.

entries.name: FM-1 Walkthrough
entries.summary: Single-page trainer that teaches four songs' sounds on the FM-1 step by step, with the stock V16 screen, a panel diagram and an audio clip for each setting.

entries.name: FMY262
entries.summary: OPL3 (YMF262) tracker for the FM-1 with 18 FM channels, 2 and 4-operator instruments, percussion mode, Adlib Tracker II effects and macros, four song slots and a browser workbench that imports AT2 and RAD songs.

entries.name: GAMELAN
entries.summary: Self-playing gamelan firmware for the FM-1 that generates Javanese and Balinese-inspired pieces in pelog and slendro and draws each gong cycle as a mandala.

entries.name: JAZZ TRIO
entries.summary: Self-playing jazz piano trio firmware for the FM-1 that plays an endless set of generated tunes on piano, upright bass and drums, shown from a table in a small club.

entries.name: LOFI RADIO
entries.summary: Self-playing lo-fi hip-hop firmware for the FM-1 that generates tracks with jazzy keys, swung drums and vinyl crackle, shown as a turntable with a spinning record.

entries.name: M-3rd-VAVE
entries.summary: Wavetable polysynth module for fm1-dock with 24 voices of three wavetable oscillators each on the PPG Wave 2.2's 28 wavetables, 39 presets, a chord generator, an arpeggiator and a loop recorder.

entries.name: MINIMAL MACHINE
entries.summary: Self-playing minimal techno firmware for the FM-1 built from six loops of different lengths that phase against each other and mutate slowly, shown as rotating rings.

entries.name: MONODRONE
entries.summary: Drone instrument with four layers of held chords from twelve engines, dirt, filter, tape delay and reverb, sixteen scenes with animated 1-bit places and no sequencer.

entries.name: NIGHT DRIVE
entries.summary: Self-playing synthwave firmware for the FM-1 that drives an endless generated track of rolling bass, arpeggios and gated drums past a neon grid road toward a striped sun.

entries.name: Obscura Line
entries.summary: Railway adventure game for the FM-1 that mixes driving a train around a synthwave loop with sound puzzles, synth jams and rhythm games, with twelve stations and a story in plain text files.

entries.name: oual FM-1
entries.summary: Work-in-progress port of Philip Meyer's oual_qroccss Max patch to the FM-1: ten looping sample voices with crush, sample-rate reduction, drive, AM, random start position and an envelope, running on the device with no co…

entries.name: Patch Bay
entries.summary: Self-patching virtual modular synth firmware for the FM-1 that draws sixteen modules with coloured cables and keeps re-patching itself to new music, always in key.

entries.name: RAND
entries.summary: Percussion synth with two oscillators, FM and sync, a Moog-style ladder filter, an eight-step sequencer whose clock runs fast enough to turn rhythm into a tone, and a patchbay on the keys.

entries.name: Shruthi FM-1
entries.summary: Port of the Mutable Instruments Shruthi-1 voice to the FM-1 as a SHRUTHI engine for Felucca, with 12 presets, a patch step that adds it to a Felucca build and a CI-built installer page and browser demo.

entries.name: Sober Groove
entries.summary: Virtual-pet recovery companion for musicians on the FM-1: a pixel-art buddy to care for, teach riffs to and keep company through craving waves, with day counts, five stages and an SOS timer.

entries.name: STACK (Maker Hip)
entries.summary: Eight-track groovebox beta with 69 built-in sounds or samples sent from the Burger Studio app, DJ-style effects, a 16-step sequencer, a looper on track 8, a PERFORM mode and MIDI clock in or out over USB and Bluetooth.

entries.name: Teachie Beachie
entries.summary: SLOOP 3 with thirty guided lessons built into the FM-1: each lesson shows a card and a strip on the screen, blinks the key to press and checks the step before moving on.

entries.name: Tono
entries.summary: Generative ambient firmware with four layers that share an instrument engine, each with its own sound, modulation, effects and sequencing, plus a Garden that plays factory arrangements at startup.

entries.name: mvave-tank-mini-findings
entries.summary: Portuguese-language hardware research notes for the Tank Mini (V011): USB descriptors, 1 MiB flash map and regions to preserve, boot and recovery limits, footswitch and LED pins, audio clocks and DSP timing.

entries.name: MMCTool
entries.summary: Pocket instrument firmware for the Cardputer and Cardputer ADV, with ten instruments including a six-voice polyphonic synth, bass, guitar, harp, piano and three drum kits, live effects and an SD card WAV recorder.

entries.name: S8N Synth
entries.summary: Turns the original Cardputer and an M5 Unit Synth or Unit MIDI into a pocket groovebox, with a keyboard, an eight-lane 16-step grid, four patterns, WAV sample pads, microphone takes and project slots on the SD card.

entries.name: WaveOS
entries.summary: Custom Cardputer ADV firmware that is a menu of apps with an SD card music player, a polyphonic synth, a four-track looper and a 16-step drum machine, alongside an IR remote, tools, notes and games.

entries.name: ORCA for Teletype (AE Modular Telex)
entries.summary: Port of the ORCA live-coding language to the Teletype's AT32UC3B0512, tuned for the AE Modular Telex clone with 0 to 5 V outputs, a 64 by 64 grid, scales, swing, a CV input operator and scene merging for flashing.

entries.name: Computer Tracker

devices.name: Music Thing Modular Workshop System Computer

entries.summary: Tracker sequencer with 4 drum synths, 2 CV/gate tracks, 2 audio-in VCA tracks and a WebMIDI editor.

entries.name: GridsWebApp
entries.summary: Browser editor and sequencer for the Grids drum map: morph between the factory nodes, edit 32-step kick, snare and hi-hat patterns with velocity, listen to the result and export a patched firmware WAV.

entries.name: open-legio
entries.summary: Noise Engineering's open-source framework for writing custom Legio firmware, with a hardware access layer, an example firmware and Node.js build, flash and debug scripts.

entries.name: open-versio
entries.summary: Noise Engineering's open-source framework for writing custom Versio firmware, with a hardware access layer, an example firmware and Node.js build, flash and debug scripts.

entries.name: Amalthea
entries.summary: Replaces the TrimUI Brick's operating system with a minimal Linux for music apps: a generative 12-track Tracker, an FX rack for an M-VAVE FM-1's USB audio and the LIFEBLOOD effect network, sharing a set of synth engines…

entries.name: Mutable Dreams for handhelds
entries.summary: Port of the Mutable Dreams generative instrument to handhelds, with six tracks, 128 worlds, a Sound Lab with Mutable Instruments-based modules and musical toys. It runs as a Ports app on the Brick under Knulli, and has…

entries.name: GP-200 Global Tap Tempo
